content: {"like": ["Laura Benanti and Christian Borle sparkle and sing the two cynical songs, providing a nice balance to the more sweet songs.", "Audra McDonald as the Mother Abbess brings a Broadway star quality that makes the show belong to her.", "The scenes involving the Nazi Anschluss and the climax play out with real dramatic conviction and depth."], "dislike": ["Carrie Underwood is underwhelming as Maria, cannot act, and often looks painfully out of her depth.", "The production feels cold and calculated, aimed at ratings rather than quality.", "The set, including the Nonnberg Abbey and mountainside, looks frightening and foreboding, not inspiring.", "Stephen Moyer as Captain Von Trapp often seems like he is suffering from an upset stomach.", "Overall, the show is a high school level production, mediocre and lacking in interest until over an hour has passed."]}
